kamloops.title: BC NDP promises to cap grocery profits while Conservatives unveil wildfire plan
kamloops.description: BC Conservative leader Lorne Doerkson visited a family whose Summerland home was destroyed by the Bald Range wildfire in the summer.

kamloops.title: Alleged kidnapping victim tells police they were taken from Lower Mainland to Kelowna
kamloops.description: Police say they believe the victim was targeted and being held "to exert pressure on an associate" and say the victim is not believed to be involved in criminal activity.

northwest.title: New totem pole raised in Hagwilget, B.C., for 1st time in 85 years
northwest.description: A new unity pole has been raised in Hagwilget, B.C., for the first time in 85 years. Four carvers worked on it for two years, while dozens of people helped hoist it into place on the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation.

northwest.title: LNG Canada to use Chinese steel on $33B expansion project in Kitimat, B.C.
northwest.description: LNG Canada says because Canadian suppliers are unable to make what it needs, it once again plans to use Chinese steel in its $33-billion Phase 2 expansion project in Kitimat, B.C. The expansion of its pipeline network, however, has set a 70 per cent target for Canadian steel.
